projects.title: GeoAI land-cover classification of Islamabad
projects.summary: A Random Forest trained on Sentinel-2 bands, spectral indices and texture maps five land-cover classes across Islamabad and the Margalla Hills, tested on spatially held-out 1 km blocks.
projects.thumbnail_alt: Random Forest land-cover prediction for Islamabad: forest in the Margalla Hills, built-up sectors and cropland to the south-east.

projects.title: Karachi coast: waterline and mangrove change, 2016–2024
projects.summary: Two Sentinel-2 scenes from the same orbit map how the waterline and coastal mangrove canopy changed along Clifton, DHA and the Korangi and Phitti creeks.
projects.thumbnail_alt: Change map of the Karachi coast with new land in lime green on the creek islands south of the city.

projects.title: Land cover by regency: Bali, Indonesia (2024)
projects.summary: An automated ArcGIS Pro workflow that mosaics Sentinel-2 10 m land-cover tiles and uses Tabulate Area to report hectares and percent of each class for Bali's nine regencies.
projects.thumbnail_alt: Land-cover map of Bali with forest in green, built-up land in red and cropland in orange.
